planets.name: WASP-28 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of WASP-28 with a 3.41-day year, found in 2014.

text.card: WASP-28 b was found in 2014 by SuperWASP as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around WASP-28. Its orbit and size follow Močnik et al. 2020's fit, the archive's default.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname MO__X10D_NIK_ET_AL__2020): disc_year 2014, disc_facility SuperWASP, sy_pnum 1; pl_orbper 3.40883495, pl_radj 1.219, pl_bmassj 0.889

quotes.title: WASP-28b
quotes.card: WASP-28b or K2-1b is an extrasolar planet discovered in 2010 by the Wide Angle Search for Planets (WASP) project orbiting WASP-28, a magnitude 12 star also known as 1SWASP J233427.87-013448.1, 2MASS J23342787-0134482 and K2-1.
quotes.introduction: Since it orbits its star very closely, the planet is a strongly irradiated hot Jupiter.
